title: Food & Drink
grammarNotes: Spanish keeps the definite article even when talking about food in general: 'Me gusta el café' (I like coffee), not 'me gusta café' — dropping 'el' sounds foreign, unlike in English.
'Estoy lleno/llena' (I'm full) uses 'estar' because it's a temporary state, not a permanent trait — this is the same estar you'll see for moods and conditions throughout the app.
'Tengo hambre' and 'tengo sed' use 'tener' + noun, not 'estar' + adjective — Spanish treats hunger and thirst as things you 'have,' not states you 'are.'

sentences.es: ¿Me puede traer la cuenta, por favor?
sentences.en: Could you bring me the check, please?
Hey, can you pass me the salt?
Hi there, what desserts do you have today?

sentences.es: Señorita, disculpe, ¿podría traernos dos cafés más?
sentences.en: Miss, excuse me, could you bring us two more coffees?
This is really tasty, did you cook it?

sentences.es: ¿Nos podría recomendar algún plato típico de la región?
sentences.en: Could you recommend a typical dish from the region?

sentences.es: La sopa está un poco fría, ¿me la podría calentar?
sentences.en: The soup is a bit cold, could you warm it up for me?

sentences.es: No sabía que te gustaba tanto el picante.
sentences.en: I didn't know you liked spicy food so much.

sentences.es: Voy a pedir la carne, pero sin cebolla, por favor.
sentences.en: I'll order the meat, but without onion, please.

sentences.es: ¿Tienen alguna opción sin gluten en el menú?
sentences.en: Do you have any gluten-free options on the menu?

sentences.es: Prueba esto, te va a encantar, en serio.
sentences.en: Try this, you're going to love it, seriously.
Excuse me, could you pass me the water?

sentences.es: Nunca había comido algo tan dulce como este postre.
sentences.en: I had never eaten something as sweet as this dessert.
How much do I owe you for breakfast?

sentences.es: Che, pidamos algo para compartir, tengo poca hambre.
sentences.en: Hey, let's order something to share, I'm not that hungry.

dialogue.speaker: mesero
dialogue.es: Buenas, bienvenidos, ¿ya saben qué van a pedir o les doy un minuto?
dialogue.en: Hi, welcome, do you already know what you'd like, or do you need a minute?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Pues, o sea, todavía no decidimos bien, ¿qué nos recomienda?
dialogue.en: Well, I mean, we haven't quite decided — what do you recommend?

dialogue.speaker: mesero
dialogue.es: Bueno, el plato del día es pescado con arroz, está buenísimo.
dialogue.en: Well, today's special is fish with rice, it's really good.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Ah, perfecto, entonces eso para mí, y... ¿verdad que el jugo de mango es natural?
dialogue.en: Ah, perfect, that one for me then, and... the mango juice is natural, right?

dialogue.speaker: mesero
dialogue.es: Sí, claro, todo natural, recién hecho.
dialogue.en: Yes, of course, all natural, freshly made.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Buenísimo, entonces eso, y la cuenta aparte, por favor.
dialogue.en: Great, that one then, and the check separately, please.
